package vparquet4

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/jsonpb"
	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/proto"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb"
	cv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/common/v1"
	tv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/trace/v1"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/traceql"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/backend"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/encoding/common"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"testing"
)

// Synthetic public Tempo v2.9.0 engine/actual Parquet fetch, not a deployed query.
func TestPulseSearchExpressions(t *testing.T) {
	dir := "/tmp/pulse-trace-expressions"
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	iv := func(n int64) *cv.AnyValue { return &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_IntValue{IntValue: n}} }
	sv := func(s string) *cv.AnyValue { return &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_StringValue{StringValue: s}} }
	routes := []*cv.AnyValue{sv("/health"), sv("/work"), nil, iv(123), sv("prefix/health/suffix"), sv("/work"), sv("/health"), {Value: &cv.AnyValue_BoolValue{BoolValue: false}}}
	codes := []*cv.AnyValue{iv(200), iv(503), nil, sv("503"), iv(500), iv(9007199254740993), iv(200), {Value: &cv.AnyValue_DoubleValue{DoubleValue: 503.5}}}
	durations := []uint64{100000000, 600000000, 1, 500000000, 500000001, 600000000, 100000000, 1000000000}
	all := &tempopb.Trace{}
	var rows []*Trace
	for i := range routes {
		start := uint64(100+i) * 1000000000
		r := batch(i+1, "frontend", "request", 1, 0, start, start+durations[i])
		s := r.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0]
		s.Status = &tv.Status{}
		if i == 0 {
			s.Status.Code = tv.Status_STATUS_CODE_OK
		}
		if i == 1 {
			s.Status.Code = tv.Status_STATUS_CODE_ERROR
		}
		if routes[i] != nil {
			s.Attributes = append(s.Attributes, &cv.KeyValue{Key: "http.route", Value: routes[i]})
		}
		if codes[i] != nil {
			s.Attributes = append(s.Attributes, &cv.KeyValue{Key: "http.response.status_code", Value: codes[i]})
		}
		resources := []*tv.ResourceSpans{r}
		if i == 6 {
			child := batch(i+1, "worker", "background", 2, 1, start+2000000000, start+2600000000)
			child.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].Status = &tv.Status{Code: tv.Status_STATUS_CODE_ERROR}
			child.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].Attributes = []*cv.KeyValue{value("http.route", "/work"), {Key: "http.response.status_code", Value: iv(503)}}
			resources = append(resources, child)
		}
		tr := &tempopb.Trace{ResourceSpans: resources}
		all.ResourceSpans = append(all.ResourceSpans, resources...)
		row, _ := traceToParquet(&backend.BlockMeta{}, s.TraceId, tr, nil)
		rows = append(rows, row)
	}
	block := makeBackendBlockWithTraces(t, rows)
	queries := []string{
		`span.http.route !~ "/health"`,
		`span.http.route !~ ".*health.*"`,
		`span.http.route != "/health"`,
		`status = error || span.http.response.status_code >= 500`,
		`span.http.route !~ "/health" && duration > 500ms`,
		`(status = error || span.http.response.status_code >= 500) && resource.service.name = "frontend"`,
		`status = ok || status = unset`,
		`span:status != error`,
		`duration = 500ms`,
		`span:duration >= 500.000001ms`,
		`duration < 1.5s`,
		`duration > 1s && resource.service.name = "frontend"`,
		`span.http.response.status_code = 9007199254740993`,
		`span.http.response.status_code = 9007199254740992`,
		`span.http.response.status_code != 503`,
		`span.http.response.status_code < 504`,
		`span.http.response.status_code > 503`,
		`span.http.route = "/work" || span.http.route = "/health" && status = ok`,
		`(span.http.route = "/work" || span.http.route = "/health") && status = ok`,
		`resource.service.name = "worker" || status = ok`,
		`status = error || span.http.response.status_code >= 9000`,
		`(status = error && span.http.response.status_code >= 9000) || span.http.route = "/work"`,
		`status = ok || (status = error && duration > 500ms)`,
		`span.http.route !~ "/health" && duration > 0.5s`,
	}
	type Case struct {
		Query    string          `json:"query"`
		Response json.RawMessage `json:"response"`
	}
	cases := []Case{}
	consumed := 0
	for i, q := range queries {
		q = "{ " + q + " } with (most_recent=true)"
		response, err := traceql.NewEngine().ExecuteSearch(context.Background(), &tempopb.SearchRequest{Query: q, Start: 99, End: 200, Limit: 100, SpansPerSpanSet: 3}, traceql.NewSpansetFetcherWrapper(func(ctx context.Context, req traceql.FetchSpansRequest) (traceql.FetchSpansResponse, error) {
			return block.Fetch(ctx, req, common.DefaultSearchOptions())
		}))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v", q, err)
		}
		response.Metrics = nil
		for _, tr := range response.Traces {
			for _, ss := range tr.SpanSets {
				for _, sp := range ss.Spans {
					sort.Slice(sp.Attributes, func(i, j int) bool { return sp.Attributes[i].Key < sp.Attributes[j].Key })
				}
			}
		}
		out, err := (&jsonpb.Marshaler{}).MarshalToString(response)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		cases = append(cases, Case{q, json.RawMessage(out)})
		wire, readErr := os.ReadFile(fmt.Sprintf("%s/consumer-%d.protobuf", dir, i))
		if readErr != nil {
			if os.Getenv("PULSE_REQUIRE_SEARCH_EXPRESSION_CONSUMER") == "1" {
				t.Fatal(readErr)
			}
		} else {
			var decoded tempopb.SearchResponse
			if err := proto.Unmarshal(wire, &decoded); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			got, err := (&jsonpb.Marshaler{}).MarshalToString(&decoded)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			var wantMap, gotMap map[string]any
			if err = json.Unmarshal([]byte(out), &wantMap); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err = json.Unmarshal([]byte(got), &gotMap); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if len(response.Traces) == 0 {
				delete(wantMap, "traces")
				delete(gotMap, "traces")
				if len(decoded.Traces) != 0 {
					t.Fatal("unexpected consumer traces")
				}
			}
			wantJSON, _ := json.Marshal(wantMap)
			gotJSON, _ := json.Marshal(gotMap)
			if string(wantJSON) != string(gotJSON) {
				t.Fatalf("consumer mismatch %s: got %s want %s", q, gotJSON, wantJSON)
			}
			consumed++
		}
	}
	wire, err := proto.Marshal(all)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = os.WriteFile(dir+"/input.protobuf", wire, 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	out, err := json.MarshalIndent(cases, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = os.WriteFile(dir+"/oracle.json", append(out, '\n'), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	type DurationCase struct {
		Literal  string `json:"literal"`
		Nanos    int64  `json:"nanos"`
		Accepted bool   `json:"accepted"`
	}
	durationCases := []DurationCase{}
	for _, literal := range []string{"0ns", "1us", "1µs", "1h30m", "1.5s", "500.000001ms", "0.3333333333333333333333m", "0.99999999999999999999999s", "0.0000000001s", "9223372036854775807ns", "9223372036854775808ns", "2562048h"} {
		req, err := traceql.ExtractFetchSpansRequest("{duration = " + literal + "}")
		c := DurationCase{Literal: literal}
		if err == nil {
			if len(req.Conditions) != 1 || len(req.Conditions[0].Operands) != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected literal condition: %#v", req)
			}
			n, ok := req.Conditions[0].Operands[0].Duration()
			if !ok {
				t.Fatal("not duration")
			}
			c.Nanos = int64(n)
			c.Accepted = true
		}
		durationCases = append(durationCases, c)
	}
	out, err = json.MarshalIndent(durationCases, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = os.WriteFile(dir+"/durations.json", append(out, '\n'), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("queries=%d public consumers=%d duration literals=%d", len(cases), consumed, len(durationCases))
}
